name: Locator Map
description: A framework-free Web Component that searches a list of offices without diacritics and flies a real map to the one chosen. The map surface is an adapter: Leaflet by default, Google with a key, and a drawing that fetches nothing when neither can be reached.

variants.name: Default
variants.description: Offices on the map, a search above it, and the flight that follows a choice.

variants.name: Search
variants.description: Typing without diacritics, the keyboard, and what happens when nothing matches.

variants.name: Detail
variants.description: The card that opens over the chosen office, and the way back to the whole country.

variants.name: Regions
variants.description: Narrowing the offices to one part of the country, and what the search then sees.

variants.name: Controls
variants.description: Zooming, dragging and panning by key, with markers that never change size.

variants.name: States
variants.description: One office, no offices at all, parts taken off, and a map that holds still when asked to.

variants.name: Adapter
variants.description: Swapping the real map for a grid and for the built-in drawing, live, without the search losing its place.
